name: gastos-firebase-functions
description: Firebase Functions for WhatsApp expense tracking

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.seed:gasto: npm run build && node lib/scripts/seed-emulator.js --enqueue 50 almuerzo
scripts.seed:sinclasificar: npm run build && node lib/scripts/seed-emulator.js --enqueue 99 cosa raruna xyz
scripts.seed:saldo: npm run build && node lib/scripts/seed-emulator.js --enqueue saldo
scripts.seed:ingreso: npm run build && node lib/scripts/seed-emulator.js --enqueue ingreso 200 sueldo
scripts.smoke: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions "node lib/scripts/smoke-emulator.js"
